description: Suggest three to five verified pros to invite to a pro ask: the listed ones, by field. Narrow by `q` (what the pro ask needs, or any words: Android, payments, a name) and `available` (open to work now). Each row: who they are, "LinkedIn verified · date" with their LinkedIn, their rate, their page with their record, and how to invite them. Newest verification first; nothing ranks them, and the person chooses. Then invite_to_call. A private page is in no list, yet any verified pro can be invited by their exact @handle or ixo1 address. With `handle` (an exact @handle or an ixo1 address) it reads that one person's public page instead: who they are, what they do, their rate, and the address to invite. Spends nothing.

available.description: true: only pros open to work now.

handle.description: One person's public page instead: their exact @handle or ixo1 address.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

q.description: What the pro ask needs, or any words (Android, payments, a name): searched across each listed pro's page, as the directory's search box does.

name: find_pro
title: Find pros, or one person's page
